text: README.md defines a rollout and dogfood checklist for this repository: run `uv run og status --json` and confirm top-level status and state are ok; run `uv run og sync --json` and confirm status ok with `distill`, `apply`, `verify`, and `export` steps; run `uv run og verify --changed --json` and confirm status ok, `verify` and `export` steps, and non-empty `verified_capsules`; then run `uv run og drift` to confirm policy and certificate health.
